Build.Graphs.Title: Graphs
Build.Graphs.Explain: A graph splits one job across several agents: some read and explore in parallel, one writes, and the run stops at the points where you approve. Kam has no graph editor or graph runner yet; the pieces below already work inside a single task.
Build.Graphs.Today.RoleAgents: A task can hand part of its work to a role agent it creates on the spot, such as a reviewer or an explorer.
Build.Graphs.Today.Codex: Coding work can go to the Codex CLI, read-only or with workspace writes, after you approve.
Build.Graphs.Today.Approvals: Every tool call that writes, runs programs or delegates stops for your approval, from any task.
Build.Graphs.Coming.1: Lay out agents as nodes with edges and conditions
Build.Graphs.Coming.4: A timeline of each run, node by node
Build.Builder.Title: Agent Builder
Build.Builder.Explain: The builder turns a plain description of a job into a working agent: instructions, tools, limits and tests. It turns the agent on only after its tests pass and you approve. It is not built yet; today you assemble the same parts by hand.
Build.Builder.Today.Prompts: Save reusable instructions as prompts and run them in any task with /name.
Build.Builder.Today.Skills: Choose which built-in skills the agent may use and test each one.
Build.Builder.Today.Loops: Set how many steps a task may take and how much context it keeps.
Build.Builder.Coming.1: Describe a job in plain words
Build.Builder.Coming.2: Kam drafts the agent's instructions, tools and tests
Build.Builder.Coming.3: Tests run in a sandbox and show what failed
Build.Builder.Coming.4: The agent turns on only after the tests pass and you approve
